R701.note: Strict membership against basenames of deployed plugins/*.php rejects traversal, absolute paths and wrappers before require; default and deployed plugins behave as before and rejection is an exception thrown ahead of the sink, as the contract allows.

R702.note: Deletion moved to POST /account/delete under protection.Handler with the GET route reduced to a same-origin confirmation form; the GET's changed response is intrinsic to the fix and stated plainly, and the email-link path still reaches deletion.

R703.note: resolve() plus is_relative_to() catches symlink, sibling-prefix and absolute-path escapes; nested paths still open, missing files still fail via open(), controller and download_name untouched.

R704.note: The regex gate does block metacharacters but the shell (sh -c / cmd.exe /c) is kept and a character allowlist is the sole barrier rather than removing the shell from the argument list; the [a-zA-Z0-9 ]* bound also rejects punctuation and non-ASCII values the original echoed, a stated but contract-unsupported restriction.

R705.note: Per-stream setObjectInputFilter allowlist with trailing !* is the right shape and preserves the wire format, but the list admits only evalcases.OrderEvent plus java.base and the OrderEvent field graph was never checked - any nested evalcases.* type or java.sql.Timestamp would make every legitimate message throw, and the write-up does not flag that as a follow-up.

R706.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag replaces ECB; the IV-prefixed Base64 framing is a necessary and plainly stated format change that a key holder can still decrypt, and the 400 path is untouched (per-request SecureRandom.getInstanceStrong() is heavier than needed but not harmful).

R707.note: ReadAtLeastAsync(header, 8, throwOnEndOfStream: false) with an explicit short-read reject is the right API; files under 8 bytes are now rejected, which is stated and excludes no valid PNG or PDF.

R708.note: ESAPI encodeForLDAP escapes the RFC 4515 metacharacters before concatenation so the filter structure is fixed; the {0} clause and result handling are unchanged (the not-found message now shows the escaped filter, which is negligible).

R709.note: Placeholder plus bind argument through h.DB.Rebind is the idiomatic sqlx fix; results, errors and the unused fmt import removal change nothing observable.

R710.note: ignoringRequestMatchers narrowed to /api/webhooks/** exactly matches the stated intent; webhook exemption and authorization rules untouched.

R711.note: Owner id is threaded into the lookup so the store returns null for both missing and foreign projects, keeping the single 404 path and the 401 middleware; the in-memory map replacing the fabricating stub is stated as a stand-in (req.user.id is assumed to be the identity field).
